purpose: Focused Protected Mode Ghidra contract for scheduler reset, selected-bank cleanup, player recovery reconstruction, and secondary callback dispatch.

source.independent_project_check: passed; project-a and project-b outputs matched

contracts.name: player_object_reinitialize_0B56
contracts.calling_convention: near/far recovery helper; no stable caller-consumed return flags; 0E06 returns ES:DI
contracts.inputs_outputs: Writes DS:7966=0 and DS:7566/DS:7766=FFFF; calls 0E06 with DX=0 and AX=0x3F27; publishes returned DI at DS:881A and writes object +0x17=2.
contracts.scheduler_position: Rebuilds the scheduler before the next recovered 0E96 pass; object insertion is performed by 0E06 -> 1036.
contracts.object_effects: Allocates the persistent player object and promotes it to phase 2.

contracts.name: register_object_scheduler_entry_1036
contracts.calling_convention: far; ES:DI pooled object; early RETF when object +0x18 is zero; no stable return flags
contracts.inputs_outputs: Appends the object's +0x1C secondary callback, +0x18 phase callback, and DI object offset at DS:7566 + DS:7966; advances DS:7966 by eight and writes the next phase word as FFFF.
contracts.scheduler_position: The allocator's publication edge for phase and secondary callbacks.
contracts.object_effects: Makes the object visible to the rotating scheduler bank.

contracts.name: clear_selected_scheduler_callbacks_106A
contracts.calling_convention: far; no stable return flags; selected bank is derived from the pre-toggle DS:7966 value
contracts.inputs_outputs: Calls an unresolved entry helper, toggles DS:7966 to the other bank selector, walks the old bank until phase callback FFFF, clears object +0x18 when object +0x1A is FFFF, and otherwise calls 17D4 with the old bank bit in BX.
player_fields_written: object +0x18 for entries whose +0x1A is FFFF
global_fields_written: selected scheduler object callbacks through ES:DI
contracts.scheduler_position: Runs in the 4BA4 lifecycle branch before 4BD8 recovery selection and before 1AF5 -> 1AAA -> 0B56 rebuild.
contracts.object_effects: Removes phase callbacks from selected objects and clears pending ARE event records for the other selected entries.
contracts.confidence: confirmed_static; entry far-call side effect unresolved

contracts.name: clear_are_event_queue_17D4
contracts.calling_convention: far; BX is supplied by 106A but is not consumed by the visible body; RETF with no caller-consumed flags
contracts.inputs_outputs: Scans 0x80 eight-byte records at DS:6586; for each nonzero pointer clears byte +0x01 of the pointed event record and then clears the slot pointer.
contracts.scheduler_position: Nested in selected-bank cleanup; does not alter scheduler entry words.
contracts.object_effects: Clears pending ARE-event ownership markers; no direct player movement or descriptor write.

contracts.name: dispatch_secondary_callbacks_0FA2
contracts.calling_convention: far scheduler pass; callback return flags are not consumed
contracts.inputs_outputs: Selects DS:7566 + (DS:7966 & 0x0200), stops on phase callback FFFF, skips zero secondary callbacks, and invokes each +0x02 callback with near CALL AX using the entry object offset.
contracts.scheduler_position: Runs after 0E96 in each main-loop scheduler pair; after recovery it consumes the bank rebuilt by 0B56.
contracts.object_effects: Dispatches secondary presentation/effect callbacks; simulation feedback remains callback-specific.
contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: no direct write; indirect callback effects remain classified separately
